families.name: skip-field profile eligibility
families.reason: I0 skip-field carriage is closed only for idx0
families.dimensions: profile=idx1..idx4; container=raw; carriage=i0-skipfld; emdf=etsi|deployed; partition=6|3+3|2+2+2|1x6|1+2+3; dependent_count=0..8 where the current resolver reaches this reason; lfe=absent|independent|dependent-supplement|dependent-replacement where valid; bitrate=1024..4864 lattice
families.public_semantics: Requires targeted profile/carriage audit. Seven-input profiles cannot obtain their additional full-band programme inputs from an I0-only carrier; phase-profile idx3 must be checked separately because it reuses the five-input family.

families.name: skip-field independent LFE
families.reason: skip-field LFE ownership has no validated source-derived path
families.dimensions: profile=idx0; container=raw; carriage=i0-skipfld; emdf=etsi|deployed; partition=6|3+3|2+2+2|1x6|1+2+3; dependent_count=0; lfe=independent; bitrate=1024..4864 lattice
families.public_semantics: LFE is optional and bypasses JOC; an I0-only carrier can own it independently if the carrier frame and skip-field writer preserve the public LFE element.

families.name: skip-field canonical short partitions
families.reason: deployed skip-field signaling has only a validated six-block carriage
families.dimensions: profile=idx0; container=raw; carriage=i0-skipfld; emdf=etsi|deployed; partition=3+3|2+2+2|1x6|1+2+3; dependent_count=0; lfe=absent; bitrate=1024..4864 lattice
families.public_semantics: Requires source-derived short I0 frames with audio-block skip fields; mixed 1+2+3 remains publicly ambiguous and is not part of canonical closure.

families.name: legacy-core LFE ownership
families.reason: legacy-core LFE ownership has no validated composition path
families.dimensions: profile=idx0..idx4; container=raw; carriage=legacy-ac3; emdf=etsi|deployed; partition=6; dependent_count=1; lfe=independent|dependent-supplement|dependent-replacement; bitrate=1024..4864 lattice
families.public_semantics: AC-3 I0 may own the optional bypassed LFE, and the E-AC-3 D0 can supplement or replace it with a public channel map; exactly-one final programme owner must remain enforced.

families.name: legacy-core deployed EMDF
families.reason: legacy-core closure is validated only with strict EMDF
families.dimensions: profile=idx0..idx4; container=raw; carriage=legacy-ac3; emdf=deployed; partition=6; dependent_count=1; lfe=absent; bitrate=1024..4864 lattice
families.public_semantics: EMDF signaling is an independent axis from legacy AC-3/E-AC-3 carriage; the existing writer already owns the deployed codec-data omission and needs representative validation.
